own_names: 出雲大社 (Izumo Ōyashiro; often read Izumo Taisha)
culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At Izumo Ōyashiro the form of prayer is two bows, four claps and one bow, rather than the two claps usual elsewhere. Pray first at the Yatsuashi gate in front of the main hall, then walk anticlockwise around the fence to the other halls.
culture-and-protocol.note: Izumo Ōyashiro only, from the shrine's FAQ.

sources.title: よくあるご質問
sources.supports: two bows, four claps, one bow; route (read directly 2026-11-05)

festivals.what: Kamiari-sai at Izumo Ōyashiro (when the gods are held to gather in Izumo): the shrine publishes the dates in its yearly festival calendar. 2026: Kamimukae welcome rite 18 November 7pm; Kamiari-sai 19, 23 and 25 November; Karasade-sai send-off 25 November 4pm.
